title: DACA: Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent for Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding
title_zh: DACA：用于零样本 3D 视觉定位的双锚点协作智能体
abstract_en: 3D visual grounding (3D-VG) is a task that bridges the natural language and 3D space, serving as a foundational capability for embodied intelligence and human-computer interaction. Although recent 3D-VG agents overcome the reliance on pre-processed 3D point clouds, they essentially employ a unidirectional, pipeline-style tool-calling architecture. This architecture separates semantic understanding from geometric reconstruction, leading to error accumulation and an inability to autonomously recover from failures. To address this flaw, this paper proposes the Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent (DACA), which reinterprets 3D-VG as a semantic-geometric dual-anchor collaborative reasoning paradigm. DACA comprises two complementary specialized tools: the semantic anchor tool holds the visual semantic features of the target and achieves efficient target tracking via optical flow and VLM local verification; the geometric anchor tool holds the 3D spatial geometric features of the target and performs global spatial reasoning via voxelization and multi-keypoint projection. The two components exchange information bidirectionally via a standardized tool call protocol, autonomously deciding on the next perception-action step to form a closed-loop optimization. Experiments on the ScanRefer and Nr3D benchmarks demonstrate that zero-shot DACA achieves an overall Acc@0.25 of 73.6\% on ScanRefer and 70.4\% overall accuracy on Nr3D, far surpassing the latest zero-shot 3D-VG methods. The code and models are available at https://github.com/liujia99/DACA
abstract_zh: 3D 视觉定位（3D Visual Grounding，3D-VG）旨在根据自然语言描述在三维空间中定位目标，是具身智能与人机交互的基础能力。近期的 3D-VG 智能体虽已摆脱对预处理 3D 点云的依赖，但仍采用单向流水线式工具调用，将语义理解与几何重建割裂，导致误差累积且难以自主从失败中恢复。本文提出双锚点协作智能体 DACA，将 3D-VG 重构为语义与几何双锚点协同推理任务。语义锚点保留目标的视觉语义特征，结合光流与视觉语言模型（VLM）的局部验证实现高效跟踪；几何锚点保留目标的三维空间特征，通过体素化与多关键点投影进行全局空间推理。两类工具通过标准化调用协议双向交换信息，自主选择下一步感知或行动，形成闭环优化。在零样本设置下，DACA 在 ScanRefer 上取得 73.6% 的整体 Acc@0.25，在 Nr3D 上取得 70.4% 的整体准确率，显著优于近期零样本 3D-VG 方法。代码与模型见 https://github.com/liujia99/DACA。
key_points_zh: DACA 用双向协作替代单向工具调用流水线，使语义理解与几何推理能够相互校正。
语义锚点结合光流与 VLM 局部验证跟踪目标；几何锚点借助体素化与多关键点投影进行全局空间推理。
两个锚点通过标准化工具调用协议共享信息，据此自主决定下一步感知或行动。
零样本结果：ScanRefer 整体 Acc@0.25 为 73.6%，Nr3D 整体准确率为 70.4%。
